context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 verified the complete Siempria Conteo application for Domingo Alonso Group car dealerships. Key findings: (1) Backend API 100% pass rate - all CRUD operations for users, cameras, and ranking endpoints work correctly with proper authentication. (2) Frontend 100% pass rate - all views load correctly, navigation works, CRUD operations via UI work. (3) Empty data (0 visits, 0 cameras) is EXPECTED because this dev environment has no physical Mobotix cameras connected. (4) UI correctly shows only 'visitas' (entries) without 'salidas' (exits). (5) Both DAG and Siempria logos display correctly in header and login. (6) Test credentials: admin/Conteo2024!
